sensitivity.description: How sensitive the trait is, such as PII; absent when it isn't.

Via.description: How an author acted: as a person, as a person's AI agent, or as an app on its own.

Vulnerability.description: A weakness planted or present in an asset. The Cyber DEM has no vulnerability object.

id.description: Unique in the Chronicle, across every part. Letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' and '-'; it never changes.

visibility.description: The lowest audience that may see the item. Absent means excon: an item nobody marked stays with exercise control, so ground truth fails closed.

assetId.description: The device, service, application or system that has it.

cve.description: Its CVE id, if it has one.

mitreTechniqueIds.description: The ATT&CK techniques that exploit it, as supporting detail.

knownBy.description: Personas, persona pools, sides or organizations that also know this item, whatever its visibility: what a simulated bank clerk knows about their own bank, for example.

standing.description: Stated by a person, or proposed and not yet confirmed. Absent means stated.
